summary: Automation-use secrets in the AAP database include all secret credential fields, external service tokens in controller settings and `password` survey answers; users can use credentials without seeing them. Controller decrypts SSH keys and passes them through a named pipe so they never hit disk, answers password prompts directly, and superusers can define custom credential types (for example injecting an API token into an environment variable).
questions: How does automation controller pass SSH keys to ssh?
Can users use a credential without seeing the secret?
Are SSH private keys written to disk during AAP jobs?
How do I create a custom credential type that injects an API token?
